judge.quote: 7. Architect Acheson Doyle Partners Architects, P.C., a licensed professional engineer, prepared the report which Sponsor has adopted as Sponsor's "Description of Property and Building Condition."
judge.why: The plan names two different firms for this role. The Identity of Parties 'Architect' section (P14) says Acheson Doyle Partners Architects, P.C. prepared the Description of Property report. But the database's cited page, the Exhibit A-2 'Certification of Sponsor's Architect' (P15), is on BP Architects letterhead dated September 29th, 2014, and says 'our firm' prepared the condition Report dated September 29, 2014. Neither page says which one is right, so both candidates are accurate statements of the plan.
